skills.name: clarify
skills.natural: 요구사항이 모호하지 않게 한 질문씩 물어봐줘.

skills.name: specify
skills.natural: 이 작업을 검증 가능한 요구사항으로 바꿔줘.
skills.expected_output: requirements preview or requirements.md with relevant prior learnings applied

skills.name: goal-draft
skills.expected_output: paste-ready prompt for Codex's built-in /goal under 4000 characters

skills.name: verify
skills.expected_output: PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED with evidence

skills.name: review
skills.natural: 이 diff에 ship blocker가 있는지 리뷰해줘.

skills.name: compound
skills.natural: 이번 실행에서 다음에 재사용할 교훈을 정리해줘.
skills.expected_output: ledger-ready learnings, report summary, long-term doc target, and next specify defaults

subagents.name: code-explorer
subagents.spawn_smoke: Ask for a read-only search of relevant files and expect no edits; adapter should use a read-only sandbox.

subagents.name: docs-researcher
subagents.spawn_smoke: Ask for README/AGENTS/docs references and expect file:line evidence; adapter should use a read-only sandbox.

subagents.name: gap-auditor
subagents.spawn_smoke: Pass a short Q&A log and expect CONTINUE or SUFFICIENT; adapter should use a read-only sandbox.

subagents.name: verifier
subagents.spawn_smoke: Ask to verify a concrete claim and expect PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED evidence; adapter should use a read-only sandbox.

subagents.name: code-reviewer
subagents.spawn_smoke: Ask to review a diff and expect severity-ordered findings; adapter should use a read-only sandbox.

routing.handoff: audit whether enough ambiguity has been resolved
audit whether requirements cover users, states, edge cases, constraints, and verification
find existing learning ledgers, long-term docs, and the persistence target
